```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-bands
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Frequency bands received and transmitted by the Fairphone (Gen. 6), with band edges according to 3GPP. FDD bands show uplink (UL, phone transmits) and downlink (DL, phone receives) separately; TDD bands use the same frequencies for both. The shaded areas are the band groups LB, MB, HB, and UHB used in the RF front-end. Note the logarithmic frequency axis."
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'content/fp6')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import fp6_bands as fb

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6.2))

rows = []   # (label, list of (lo, hi, kind))
for b, (ul_lo, ul_hi, dl_lo, dl_hi) in sorted(fb.FDD.items(), key=lambda x: fb.center(x[0])):
    rows.append((f'B{b}', [(ul_lo, ul_hi, 'UL'), (dl_lo, dl_hi, 'DL')]))
for b, (lo, hi) in fb.SDL.items():
    rows.append((f'B{b}', [(lo, hi, 'DL')]))
for name, (lo, hi) in fb.TDD.items():
    rows.append((name, [(lo, hi, 'TDD')]))
for name, (lo, hi) in fb.WIFI.items():
    rows.append((f'Wi-Fi {name}', [(lo, hi, 'WLAN')]))
rows.sort(key=lambda r: min(s[0] for s in r[1]))

colors = {'UL': 'tab:blue', 'DL': 'tab:orange', 'TDD': 'tab:green', 'WLAN': 'tab:purple'}
for i, (label, segs) in enumerate(rows):
    for lo, hi, kind in segs:
        ax.barh(i, hi - lo, left=lo, height=0.7, color=colors[kind])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(rows)))
ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows], fontsize=8)
ax.invert_yaxis()

for name, f in fb.GNSS.items():
    ax.axvline(f, color='k', linestyle=':', linewidth=1)
    ax.text(f * 1.01, len(rows) - 0.6, f'GNSS {name}', fontsize=8, rotation=90, va='bottom')

for name, (lo, hi) in fb.GROUPS.items():
    ax.axvspan(lo, hi, color='gray', alpha=0.12, zorder=0)
    ax.text((lo * hi)**0.5, -1.2, name, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, weight='bold')

ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlim(580, 7300)
ax.set_ylim(len(rows) - 0.4, -1.6)
ticks = [600, 800, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 7000]
ax.set_xticks(ticks)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(t) for t in ticks])
ax.minorticks_off()
ax.set_xlabel('Frequency (MHz)')
ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)

handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=c) for c in colors.values()]
ax.legend(handles, ['FDD uplink', 'FDD/SDL downlink', 'TDD', 'Wi-Fi'],
          loc='lower left', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
